# Generated by government-runtime-review/fix_conversions.py; current native holding/eligibility data.
# Character scope. Prepare an incompatible capital before changing government.
# Do not repeat change_government after a holding/title transition already selected the target.

skonester_121_transition_to_administrative_government_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ruler = yes
        }
        capital_province ?= {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        has_holding_type = castle_holding
                        has_holding_type = city_holding
                        has_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                    }
                }
                set_holding_type = castle_holding
                skonester_ensure_castle_holding_base_castle_building = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_government = administrative_government } }
            change_government = administrative_government
        }
    }
}

skonester_121_transition_to_japan_administrative_government_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ruler = yes
            has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
        }
        capital_province ?= {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        has_holding_type = castle_holding
                        has_holding_type = city_holding
                        has_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                        has_holding_type = tribal_holding
                    }
                }
                set_holding_type = castle_holding
                skonester_ensure_castle_holding_base_castle_building = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_government = japan_administrative_government } }
            top_liege = { save_scope_as = skonester_japan_transition_top_liege }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:skonester_japan_transition_top_liege = { has_character_flag = tgp_japan_restore_japanese_government_flag } }
                change_government = japan_administrative_government
            }
            else = {
                scope:skonester_japan_transition_top_liege = { add_character_flag = tgp_japan_restore_japanese_government_flag }
                change_government = japan_administrative_government
                scope:skonester_japan_transition_top_liege = { remove_character_flag = tgp_japan_restore_japanese_government_flag }
            }
        }
    }
}

skonester_121_transition_to_japan_feudal_government_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ruler = yes
            has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
        }
        capital_province ?= {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        has_holding_type = castle_holding
                        has_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                        has_holding_type = tribal_holding
                    }
                }
                set_holding_type = castle_holding
                skonester_ensure_castle_holding_base_castle_building = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_government = japan_feudal_government } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_character_flag = can_become_japanese_feudal }
                change_government = japan_feudal_government
            }
            else = {
                add_character_flag = can_become_japanese_feudal
                change_government = japan_feudal_government
                remove_character_flag = can_become_japanese_feudal
            }
        }
    }
}

skonester_121_transition_to_mandala_government_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ruler = yes
            is_landed = yes
            has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
            		OR = {
            			liege ?= { has_government = mandala_government }
            			is_independent_ruler = yes
            		}
        }
        capital_province ?= {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        has_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                        has_holding_type = church_holding
                        has_holding_type = castle_holding
                    }
                }
                set_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_government = mandala_government } }
            change_government = mandala_government
        }
    }
}

# Character scope: preserve an already matching domicile, convert a mismatched
# noble-family domicile with the native helper, or create a missing family title.
skonester_121_prepare_government_domicile_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_held_title = { is_noble_family_title = yes } }
        tgp_domicile_conversion_when_changing_government_type = {
            NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE = $NEW_DOMICILE_TYPE$
            NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE = $NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE$
        }
    }
    else = {
        give_noble_family_title = {
            save_scope_as = skonester_new_noble_family_title
            name = noble_family_name
            tier = county
            article = DEFAULT_TITLE_NAME_ARTICLE
            government = $NEW_GOVERNMENT_TYPE$
        }
        domicile ?= { set_up_domicile_estate_effect = yes }
    }
}
